title: Lost Cargo
logline: A locally revered saint's sarcophagus was accidentally loaded onto a massive automated bulk freighter during a recent planetary evacuation.

roles.description: Desperate to recover the sarcophagus before the freighter is broken down for scrap.
A massive, unlit cargo bay attached to an unfeeling machine.
A colossal, blind corporate hauling vessel executing a decades-old flight plan.
A quiet sanctuary now completely empty of its defining relic.
A distant logistics corp that genuinely has no idea they stole a saint.
Automated security drones slaved to the freighter.
The bureaucratic heart of the freighter company.

public_situation: The monks of the {role:holy_monastery} are in mourning after their most sacred relic was lost during an emergency cargo shuffle.
private_truth: The cargo wasn't stolen maliciously; a blind automated loading crane simply grabbed the wrong crate. However, the freighter's automated defenses view anyone approaching as a pirate.

beats.public_change: The acolyte tracks the relic's faint radiation signature to the massive freighter's projected path.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to quietly scan the exterior of the massive docking bay to confirm the relic is inside.
missions.private_fact: The scan accidentally trips the freighter's automated proximity alarms.

missions.reason: The acolyte needs the pilot to deliver a prayer of preservation to the shrine before the chase begins.
missions.private_fact: The acolyte believes this will protect the pilot.

beats.public_change: The freighter jumps to the next system and activates its automated defense drones in response to the alarm.

missions.reason: The acolyte needs the pilot to deliver the scan data to the monastery so they can prepare the retrieval codes.
missions.private_fact: The data proves the saint is essentially being held hostage by a garbage scow.

missions.reason: The pilot must destroy the defensive drones swarming the freighter so they can get close.
missions.private_fact: The drones are lightly armed but heavily shielded.

beats.public_change: The company realizes their freighter is under attack and offers a bounty for its protection.

missions.reason: The pilot must scan the freighter's hull to find a manual override port.
missions.private_fact: The port is damaged and highly unstable.

missions.reason: The acolyte needs the pilot to deliver a formal writ of reclamation to the company.
missions.private_fact: The company ignores the writ but logs the pilot's ship.

beats.public_change: The defenses are down, but the freighter is preparing to vent its cargo bay into a local star.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to shoot out the cargo locks and recover the sarcophagus as it spills into space.
missions.private_fact: If the pilot takes too long, the cargo will fall into the star.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has the sarcophagus in their hold. They can return it to the monastery or sell it to the freighter company as 'recovered company property'.

options.label: Return the saint to the monastery
Sell the cargo back to the corporation

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fights the drones and returns the relic.
resolutions.summary: The sarcophagus is returned to the monastery. The believers rejoice, though the corporation officially blacklists the pilot for piracy.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot risked an automated firing squad to pull a stolen holy relic off a cargo hauler.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the saint to the corporation.
resolutions.summary: The corporation melts the sarcophagus down for its rare metals. The pilot gets a corporate bonus, but the monks are devastated.
The freighter vents the cargo into the star. The saint is lost forever, and the believers are utterly crushed.

loose_threads.detail: The freighter's loading manifest shows the crane was given a manual override command from an untraceable terminal just seconds before grabbing the sarcophagus.
The radiological scan of the sarcophagus reveals the remains inside are only twenty years old, not ancient.

radio_hooks: Monks of the {role:holy_monastery} declare a month of fasting over missing relic.
{role:freighter_company} denies any knowledge of unscheduled cargo acquisitions.

voice_direction.grieving_acolyte: Stilted, formal rhythm. Refuses to use modern technological terms.
